title: Translation difference of a C¹_c function as a parametric integral of directional derivatives
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set, let ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ be C¹ with compact support, and let h ∈ ℝ^N. Then ∫_F (ψ(z − h) − ψ(z)) dz = −∫_0^1 (∫_F Dψ(z − th)[h] dz) dt. Here ∫_F is integration with respect to the restricted measure L^N⌞F, which is defined for every set F. Dψ(x)[v] is the Fréchet derivative of ψ at x applied to v, and ∫_0^1 is the interval integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn N → ℝ) (h : Rn N), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ z in F, (ψ (z - h) - ψ z) = -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ z in F, fderiv ℝ ψ (z - t • h) h
